summary: The WebSocket protocol enables two-way real-time communication between clients and servers where direct TCP and UDP are not available, such as in a browser. This proposed standard defines a WebSocket subprotocol as a reliable transport for the Message Session Relay Protocol (MSRP), so messaging can happen from web clients.

eli5.summary: Web pages cannot always use the usual plumbing for chat sessions. This lets chat messages ride inside a two-way web connection that a browser can open.
